Hi Olivia / Tim —

Great speaking with you earlier today. Per our chat I’m sending over the estimate and the brief pricing deck that maps expected throughput/latency to monthly costs for the pilot. Key callouts:

- Baseline configuration assumes 2x gpus (reserved) with autoscale to handle peak inference bursts.
- We included an optional KV-cache layer that typically reduces per-token compute by ~25% for your 1.5–2.0k token median sequences.
- SLA + logging add-on shown on page 7 for audit/log retention.

If helpful I can walk through the deck and line items in a 20–30 minute call — I usually run through the cost model and call out areas where quantization or caching would materially reduce spend.

Proposed slots: Tue 8/24 10:00–10:30 PDT, Wed 8/25 14:00–14:30 PDT, Thu 8/26 09:00–09:30 PDT. Reply with what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_Bluewake_v1.pdf (PDF, 84KB); Redwood_Pricing_Deck_2026.pptx (PPTX, 3.1MB)

Best,
Marcus Lin
